question: Should OpenClaw retain the pinned upstream installer or replace it with a directly downloaded and integrity-verified pinned OpenGrep artifact?
rationale: This security-owned CI execution path defines a permanent trust boundary, so choosing between a hardened installer and direct artifact installation requires owner intent.

options.title: Pin and verify the artifact
options.body: Download the platform artifact directly with deadlines and verify a pinned digest or signature before installation.

options.title: Harden the installer path
options.body: Download the pinned script atomically, execute it only after successful transfer, and impose a deadline on the complete installer process.

recommendation.title: Pin and verify the artifact
recommendation.body: Download the platform artifact directly with deadlines and verify a pinned digest or signature before installation.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle introduced the OpenGrep workflow and is the strongest history-backed owner for its installation trust boundary.
